76115-picture-stuff.title: Picture Stuff
76115-picture-stuff.creator: Raoul F. Whitfield
76115-picture-stuff.description: A book by Raoul F. Whitfield. That was what happened at Bakersfield. Sid Lunn blew a front left tire in a forced landing, and when we pulled him out of the wreckage he had a busted leg. Charlie Ryan taxied into a couple of carelessly-deposited fuel cans and the plane nosed over. He came out with head cuts that would stop his flying for a week.

arxiv-2203-04869.title: The Connection Between Nesterov’s Accelerated Methods and Halpern Fixed-Point Iterations
arxiv-2203-04869.creator: Quoc Tran-Dinh
arxiv-2203-04869.description: Abstract We derive a direct connection between Nesterov’s accelerated first-order algorithm and the Halpern fixed-point iteration scheme for approximating a solution of a co-coercive equation. We show that one method is equivalent to another via a simple transformation, leading to a simple convergence proof for Nesterov’s accelerated scheme.

arxiv-2207-07666.title: Nonclassical advantage in metrology established via quantum simulations of hypothetical closed timelike curves
arxiv-2207-07666.creator: David R. M. Arvidsson-Shukur, Aidan G. McConnell, Nicole Yunger Halpern
arxiv-2207-07666.description: Abstract We construct a metrology experiment in which the metrologist can sometimes amend her input state by simulating a closed timelike curve, a worldline that travels backward in time. The existence of closed timelike curves is hypothetical. Nevertheless, they can be simulated probabilistically by quantum-teleportation circuits. We leverage such simulations to pinpoint a counterintuitive nonclassical advantage achievable with entanglement.

arxiv-2210-13469.title: Symmetric function generalizations of the q q -Baker–Forrester ex-conjecture and Selberg-type integrals Thanks: *Corresponding author
arxiv-2210-13469.creator: Guoce Xin, Yue Zhou*
arxiv-2210-13469.description: Abstract . It is well-known that the famous Selberg integral is equivalent to the Morris constant term identity. In 1998, Baker and Forrester conjectured a generalization of the q q -Morris constant term identity. This conjecture was proved and extended by Károlyi, Nagy, Petrov and Volkov in 2015.

arxiv-2211-13815.title: Using Selective Masking as a Bridge between Pre-training and Fine-tuning Thanks: The author was at IIIT Hyderabad during the work.
arxiv-2211-13815.creator: Tanish Lad, Himanshu Maheshwari, Shreyas Kottukkal, Radhika Mamidi
arxiv-2211-13815.description: Abstract Pre-training a language model and then fine-tuning it for downstream tasks has demonstrated state-of-the-art results for various NLP tasks. Pre-training is usually independent of the downstream task, and previous works have shown that this pre-training alone might not be sufficient to capture the task-specific nuances.

arxiv-2305-19446.title: Hafnia HfO 2 is a Proper Ferroelectric
arxiv-2305-19446.creator: Aldo Raeliarijaona, R. E. Cohen
arxiv-2305-19446.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Aldo Raeliarijaona, R. E. Cohen. We clarify the nature of hafnia as a proper ferroelectric and show that there is a shallow double well involving a single soft polar mode as in well-known classic ferroelectrics.

arxiv-2502-00236.creator: Sara E. Holeman, Sanchayeeta Borthakur
arxiv-2502-00236.description: Abstract I Introduction This manual is specific to the procedure of reducing galaxy long-slit spectroscopic data from the Boller & Chivens Spectrograph aboard the 90” Bok telescope at Kitt Peak National Observatory. The Image Reduction Analysis Facility (IRAF) is utilized to complete the steps of image reduction.

arxiv-2508-14819.title: Synchronization driven acoustics: The nonlinear scattering of a self-oscillating meta-atom
arxiv-2508-14819.creator: Alexander K. Stoychev, Xinxin Guo, Ulrich Kuhl, Nicolas Noiray
arxiv-2508-14819.description: Abstract In this study we demonstrate a self-oscillating acoustic meta-atom functioning as an amplifying transistor, where a steady external flow serves as a control signal to switch between reflective (off-state) and transmissive (on-state) regimes. In the on-state, an acoustic limit cycle synchronizes with incident sound waves.

arxiv-2601-18307.title: Active topological strings in renewing nematopolar fluids
arxiv-2601-18307.creator: Alberto Dinelli, Ludovic Dumoulin, Karsten Kruse
arxiv-2601-18307.description: Abstract Active matter often simultaneously exhibits different kinds of orientational order and, in many cases of biological interest, undergoes continuous material renewal. In renewing nematopolar fluids we find stable topological strings, structures consisting of two nematic point defects connected by a defect line in the polar field.

pmc-10596846.title: Counting the Cost: The Economic Toll of Discrimination Against LGBTQAI+ Individuals in Italy
pmc-10596846.creator: G Altamura, A Lontano, M C Nurchis, G M Raspolini, A Heidar Alizadeh, G Santoli, P Laurenti, G Damiani
